result.title: Yet Another Concept Drift Benchmark? A Principled Framework for Evaluating Drift Detectors
result.comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data
result.summary: Concept drift detection is a fundamental component of data stream learning, yet its empirical evaluation remains based on loosely defined protocols, ambiguous alarm semantics, and inconsistent metrics. We propose a principled benchmark grounded in an explicit formulation of drift observability and alarm semantics. Our framework introduces finite detection windows and repeated alarms, enabling a clear separation between detection accuracy, timeliness, and stability, and employs a reproducible observer to provide a controlled and interpretable performance signal. Building on this formulation, we define normalized evaluation metrics and a composite score addressing limitations of existing measures. We validate the framework through a large-scale stress-testing evaluation of 10 detectors across 9 learner configurations and 16 datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文为数据流中的概念漂移检测器提出一套基于显式可观测性与告警语义定义的评测框架，引入有限检测窗口与重复告警，分离检测准确性、及时性与稳定性，并给出归一化指标与综合分数，在 10 个探测器、9 种学习器配置和 16 个数据集上做了压力测试。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「告警语义＋有限检测窗口＋及时性/稳定性分离」的评测思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 触发时机的定义与评价协议，但领域与视觉推理相距较远，需较多核查。
